Frontend: Pay-all card verified with correct data-testids and £51.00 total for 2 invoices. Regression: 215v instructor CRUD, OG image, public profile all working.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 215w features all working: (1) POST /api/memberships/instructors/{id}/invite-login creates user with account_type=instructor, returns {ok:true, user_id} or {already_linked:true}, 400 if no email, (2) GET /api/instructor/profile returns linked instructor doc, 404 if not linked, (3) PATCH /api/instructor/profile updates headline/bio/photo_url/specialties/qualifications/years_experience/social, silently ignores name/email/slug, (4) POST /api/member/invoices/pay-all returns {checkout_url, invoice_ids[], total_pence, count} with valid Stripe URL, 400 if nothing outstanding, (5) Class template instructor_id persists and copies to occurrences, (6) Member portal BOOKINGS tab shows outstanding invoices card with 'Pay £X now' button (data-testid='member-billing-outstanding', 'member-pay-all'). Frontend class editor has instructor picker dropdown (data-testid='mbr-class-instructor-picker') sourced from /memberships/instructors with free-text fallback (data-testid='mbr-class-instructor').
